notes.title: Volume 2 is Coming...
notes.notes:
🌟 Long time no see! 🌟

We’ve been working hard on Volume 2 of “Through the Edges” and the story is growing deeper, darker, and more exciting than ever! ✨

Thank you for your patience and support — your journey is just getting started. 🖤

notes.title: Through the Edges Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
🎉 Our Visual Novel is Out Now! 🎉
Hello, everyone!

It’s finally here! 🥳 Dive into the story, meet the characters, and let us know what you think!

Since this is a fresh release, some minor bugs might still be lurking. If you run into any issues, please report them – we’ll do our best to fix everything as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support! 💖 Your feedback is incredibly valuable, so don’t forget to leave a review and share your thoughts!
